messages:
pagerduty-bot: PAGERDUTY ALERT — service=embeddings-usw2 severity=P1. Incident PD-4219. Bridge: https://redwood.bridge/PD-4219

maya (eng-oncall): taking the bridge. joining in 30s. quick note: client errors + high p95/p99 latencies. saw error spike ~09:11 UTC.

jiwoo (sre): on it. looked at node metrics — memory pressure on g2-11, several OOM kills at 09:10. pushing logs to the bridge.

sam (support): two paying customers opened tickets — index jobs timing out. need a short customer ack we can send now. CS asks for ETA for mitigation.

maya (eng-oncall): short ack we can paste in Zendesk: 

---BEGIN ZENDESK MACRO---
Hi — thanks for reporting this. We’re seeing elevated latency and intermittent timeouts for embeddings in US-W2. Our on-call team is actively investigating and working on mitigation. We’ll follow up within 30 minutes with an update. Apologies for the disruption. — Redwood Inference Ops
---END ZENDESK MACRO---

sam (support): perfect. I'll send that now to the two customers and mark tickets as impacted.

carlos (solutions): adding an Intercom/CS quick snippet (shorter): 

---BEGIN INTERCOM SNIPPET---
Thanks for flagging — we’re investigating embeddings timeouts in US-W2. We’ll update in ~30m. — Redwood Ops
---END INTERCOM SNIPPET---

maya (eng-oncall): working hypothesis: GPU driver regression or memory leak in 2.3.x runtime. immediate mitigations I’m trying: 1) drain g2-11 from traffic 2) spin replacement node 3) tail logs for 502/504 patterns.

jiwoo (sre): commands I ran: 
```bash
# show kube pods on node
kubectl get pods --field-selector spec.nodeName=g2-11 -n redwood-inference
# check kernel dmesg for OOM
dmesg | grep -i oom
# recent docker logs for failing model server
docker logs model-server-xyz --since 10m
```

maya (eng-oncall): drain command: `kubectl cordon g2-11 && kubectl drain g2-11 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — doing that now. will monitor errors.

statuspage-bot: STATUSPAGE: Draft update created for incident PD-4219. Suggested status: "Investigating". Suggested public message skeleton: 

"We’re currently investigating elevated latency and intermittent timeouts for embeddings in the US-W2 region. Some customers may experience failed indexing or slow responses. Our engineers are actively working on a mitigation. We will provide updates within 30 minutes."

maya (eng-oncall): internal update (use for ops channel): 

---INTERNAL UPDATE TEMPLATE---
Severity: P1
Start: 2026-03-15T09:11:00Z
Impact: ~6% errors on embeddings-usw2; several enterprise index jobs timing out
What we know: memory pressure and OOMs on node g2-11 around 09:10 UTC; p99 latencies spiking to 18s
Action taken: cordoned and draining g2-11; spun one replacement GPU node; rolling restart of model-server replicas on the affected pod set
Next steps: observe error rate for 10m; if persists, rollback runtime 2.3.x to 2.2.9 on affected pool
Point of contact: maya (eng-oncall)
---END INTERNAL UPDATE TEMPLATE---

sam (support): CS follow-up macro for post-ack update (when we have more): 

"Update: Our engineers have identified memory pressure on an internal inference node causing timeouts. We have removed the node from rotation and are observing recovery. We’ll send another update in 15 minutes or when service is restored. — Redwood Inference"

jiwoo (sre): progress: after drain, error rate dropped to ~1.2% and p95 back to ~1.6s (was 4.9s). continuing to monitor.

maya (eng-oncall): +1 on monitoring. I'm leaving a short runbook snippet for next oncall / handoff: 

---HANDOFF CHECKLIST---
- Incident ID: PD-4219
- What happened: memory pressure -> OOMs on g2-11 caused elevated latency and timeouts for embeddings-usw2
- Actions taken: cordoned/drained g2-11; spun replacement node; rolling restart of model-server pods; created statuspage draft; customer ACKs sent
- Logs to attach: `dmesg | tail -n 200`, `kubectl describe pod <pod>` for any pod with CrashLoopBackOff, model-server logs for 09:00-09:20 UTC
- Commands to run to verify: `curl -sS https://metrics.redwood/api/metrics?svc=embeddings-usw2 | jq .p99` and `kubectl get nodes -o wide`
- Who to loop in: infra-leads, account-owners for impacted customers if problems persist
- Handoff note: if error rate >2% for 15m, escalate to oncall-manager and consider rolling back runtime to 2.2.9
---END HANDOFF CHECKLIST---

carlos (solutions): saved the Zendesk macros as ticket snippets in the CS macros library (tag: incident-emb-usw2).

sam (support): leaving them in the tickets now and pinging accounts. thanks. :thumbsup: 

jiwoo (sre): monitoring shows stable for 8m, p99 hovered 1.7s. I'll keep a watch for 30m then close incident if normal.

maya (eng-oncall): handing off to night oncall @jiwoo at 10:00 UTC. brief to include: watch p99, error rate, node evictions. Handoff message for next oncall: paste the HANDOFF CHECKLIST above into the oncall channel.

pagerduty-bot: Bridge PD-4219 closed by maya at 09:40 UTC (service stabilized).

statuspage-bot: STATUSPAGE: Update posted to status.redwood.com: "Mitigated — Elevated latency and intermittent timeouts in US-W2 (embeddings) were mitigated after removing a degraded node from rotation. We continue to monitor."

sam (support): final CS follow-up macro to send after monitoring clear: 

"Resolved: The embeddings service in US-W2 experienced short-lived timeouts due to a degraded node. We removed the node and service performance returned to normal. We apologize for the disruption and are investigating the root cause to prevent recurrence. If you saw failed indexing jobs, please reply and we’ll help re-run them or provide credits."

jiwoo (sre): will file root cause ticket (RC-4219) with logs and driver trace.

maya (eng-oncall): thanks all — great quick coordination. leaving notes in the incident doc and closing this thread. :eyes:
